title: The Hybridization of Cultures in My Creative Practice in Nollywood
lineage: Inspected the identified passage; local file contains paraphrased research notes.

passages.note: The thesis, citing Haynes, describes Nnebue and Ogunsola’s 1989 Yoruba video production and traders entering video production after Living in Bondage in 1992. It recognizes earlier video works and differing traditions.
